adopt: Snapshot one directory, break it, restore it, diff it.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
A restore that half-succeeds is worse than one that fails, because you now have a state that never existed.

Install
pip install awrecover

Commands
  awrecover

Quick start
  pip install awrecover
  
  awrecover snapshot./run --store.snaps --label pre-finetune
  awrecover verify --store.snaps --label pre-finetune # RESTORES it, to a scratch dir
  awrecover restore --store.snaps --label pre-finetune --dest./run

Docs
https://aitherium.github.io/awrecover/
synopsis: Labelled snapshots with an all-or-nothing restore.
